questions.title: THE NATHAN
questions.prompt: In Nico's futuristic nightmare, an overlord machine called THE NATHAN used magnetic fields to force humanity to do what?
options: Bring wood to one place and build a massive structure
Form a human chain around the entire planet
Carry buckets of water to an enormous empty pool
questions.explanation: Humanity had been drafted into THE NATHAN's construction project. Refusing meant a trip to a Sarlacc-pit-type situation. All of this fit into a fifteen-minute dream.

receipts.text: Oh hell nah I just had a dream I was in a hyper futuristic world and there was this overload machine called THE NATHAN and it would use magnetic force fields to force everyone in the world to bring wood to this one location and build a massive structure
And if you didn’t do it you would go into a Sarlacc pit thing
And this all happened between 6:05 and 6:20am

receipts.text: I had to let it out so I shat on the sidewalk enough to go inside and finish up in there
Then the next day my roommates were like bruh did y’all see someone’s dog took a big ass shit near our house and I was like oh… about that
Gave them bug thanksgiving

questions.title: First contact
questions.prompt: Charlie recalled a drunken encounter with a skunk in the middle of the night. How did he try to communicate with it?
options: By offering it some leftover food
By imitating the noises it made
questions.explanation: He was more scared of the skunk than it was of him, but still attempted body-language diplomacy. His follow-up to the story: 'U def asked'.

receipts.text: Weird factoid but i just randomly remembered walking past a skunk middle of the night and I was more scared of it than it was of me and I so fucking drunk I tried to do speak to it through body language
U def asked
